description.it: I titoli ad alta leggibilità, in simboli, audiolibri, a caratteri grandi o tattili, per formato, con le copie e i prestiti del periodo: per gli alunni con DSA o con disabilità.
description.en: The high-readability, symbol, audiobook, large-print or tactile titles, by format, with the copies and the loans of the period: for pupils with dyslexia or a disability.

sql: SELECT f.value AS format, b.title AS title, b.author AS author, (SELECT group_concat(DISTINCT i.call_number) FROM item i WHERE i.biblio_id = b.id AND i.status <> 'withdrawn') AS call_number, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM item i WHERE i.biblio_id = b.id AND i.status <> 'withdrawn') AS copies, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l JOIN item i ON i.id = l.item_id WHERE i.biblio_id = b.id AND date(l.issued_at) BETWEEN :from AND :to) AS loans FROM biblio b, json_each(b.accessible_formats) f ORDER BY f.value, b.title
